h1: Window cleaning in Overlook at North Lakeway
intro: Overlook at North Lakeway is a small neighborhood of 2000s production homes. CleanzATX cleans here at the same $10 per window we quote across Lakeway.

sections.h2: What Overlook at North Lakeway homes are like
paragraphs: The homes here are 2000s production builds, mostly between 2,100 and 4,000 square feet, priced from $500K to $700K. Nothing on record shows a gate or an HOA here. The subdivision is small and sits on the north side of Lakeway near North Lakeway Village and Lakeside.

Production homes tend to share a few window styles, which makes the work predictable. Many have double hung windows on the front and sliders or French doors on the back. A set of repeating floor plans makes pricing and timing easy for us to estimate.

sections.h2: What Overlook at North Lakeway windows deal with
paragraphs: After twenty years, builder grade screens and tracks collect plenty of dirt. Screens sag, tracks fill with grit and spider webs return every few weeks. Cedar pollen between December and February and live oak pollen in March and April coat the glass with a yellow film.

Builder sprinklers often spray the lower panes by design, so hard water spots are common. Over time those spots can become permanent on older glass. Our pure water rinse leaves no new minerals behind, and hard water spot removal is $10 per pane. Screens can be freshened at $5 each.

sections.h2: How we work Overlook at North Lakeway
paragraphs: The layout makes route planning simple. Streets are open, there is no gate and driveways give us room to park. We reach second story glass with water fed poles from the ground and keep ladders off the siding. Inside windows are cleaned by hand, and we wipe sills and tracks if you add them. Neighbors can share a day, and we often combine houses that are close.

For a 2,500 square foot home, exterior windows come to about $250. Plan on about two hours outside, and about 75 minutes more inside. With the inside included, each window is $15. Twice a Year takes 10% off, which suits this style of home.
